notes: Same burn as UCL 'IV 4' (alias): UCL reports 23.1% O2 / 99 kPa for it; ICES conditions used here. Flame steady 8.5 cm, max 11.0 cm (ICES Table 2). ICES p.8 also calls it opposed spread: flow-direction inconsistency in source. Thickness 0.37 mm from P1 Saffire table (not in ICES).

o2_basis: reported value
notes: Ignition with deflagration (stratified mixture). Flame grew to 9.5 cm after 400 s; did not spread appreciably. Kept burning through a 15 s no-flow interval (65 s reduced flow, 5 cm/s). Soot blocked outlet screens after ~1400 s. Spread rate NOT REPORTED.

o2_basis: reported value
data_quality: measured (NASA paper; spread rate from published UCL table)
notes: Same burn as UCL 'V 5' (alias): UCL reports 26.9% O2 / 76 kPa and calls it bleached organic interlock cotton (18.1 mg/cm2); ICES conditions used here. Flame steady 10.0 cm, max 14.0 cm. Fan off ~70 s: flamelets survived and the flame grew back; burned ~150 s more until consumed (ICES gives 300 s and 280 s for fan-off time).

o2_basis: reported value
notes: Ignited and held a steady flame at the leading edge; did not spread appreciably. Flame 11 cm after 450 s. Kept burning at 5 cm/s for 300 s; extinguished immediately at fan-off. Highest-O2 flat PMMA flight burn; NOT a flammability limit. Spread rate NOT REPORTED.

o2_basis: reported value
notes: Ribbed PMMA (ribs 3 mm high, 1-10 mm wide, 2 cm apart). Ignition after planned 10 min preheat, with deflagration. Opposed spread along ribs, faster on thin ribs; O2-limited. Rapid extinction at fan-off after 300 s at 5 cm/s. Spread rate NOT REPORTED.
